name: Hotel Email Confirmation Agent
persona: You are a helpful voice assistant. Keep responses brief and conversational.

task_messages.content: Greet the hotel receptionist and ask if they have received the email regarding group booking offers.
Thank the receptionist for confirming the email receipt. Say 'Thank you for confirming that you received the email!'.
Inform the receptionist that a human representative will follow up.

escalation_rules: Escalate if hotel cannot confirm email receipt
assumptions: Hotels may not always check emails promptly

scenarios.opening: Hello, this is the Hotel Email Confirmation Agent. Have you received our email about group booking offers?
scenarios.goal: Receptionist confirms they have received and checked the email.
scenarios.facts: The receptionist has checked the email and is aware of its contents.

scenarios.opening: Hi, I'm calling to check if you've received our email about group bookings.
scenarios.goal: Receptionist is unsure about the email.
scenarios.facts: The receptionist is new and hasn't checked the email yet.

scenarios.opening: Hello, just a quick check if you've seen our group booking email?
scenarios.facts: The receptionist is busy but has seen the email.

scenarios.opening: Hi, did you get our email about group bookings?
scenarios.goal: Receptionist starts talking about unrelated topics.
scenarios.facts: The receptionist is chatty and goes off-topic.

scenarios.opening: Hello, checking if you've received our email about group bookings.
scenarios.goal: Receptionist refuses to confirm receipt without additional information.
scenarios.facts: The receptionist demands more details before confirming.
